contexts.text: They who have been in the knowledge of faith and in a life of evil... are foul and cause aversion. (Lice.)
That infernal foulness and filth would flow in. Signified.
When the rays of light fall upon hideous forms, they are turned into hideous colours.
How foul loves are made known...
In time it becomes palatable... so that he prefers what is loathsome and bitter to what is sweet.
The Hells appear in a fire hideously reddening... and in a fire hideously flaming...
